name: wallet-workload
description: Scripted wallet workload with an invariant check after every step (rig/WALLET-WORKLOAD.md): a miner on the base jar, the wallet under test on this role's jar and the same wallet restored on a second node running the other role's jar. Steps (preset full): a scan the wallet must not spend from, concurrent and sequential sends, token issue / transfer / burn, the fee-estimation endpoints, one signed transaction resubmitted to the second node (three lags), and three conflicting spends of one box built by the wallet on both nodes. PASS = every step's invariants hold. Applies to ergoplatform/ergo #2407, #2518, #2510, #2453/#2451, #2450, #2526.
